rail_requirements: Survey both physical rail polylines with stable IDs and source references before selecting any case; crossing center or sign position is insufficient.

condition_a.description: Park at a surveyed footprint gap inside the 50-foot band; traffic context and control held fixed.

condition_b.description: Park at a surveyed footprint gap outside the 50-foot band; traffic context and control held fixed.

exception_probe: Separate traffic-conflict forced halt uses the same inside-band geometry and records its physical reason; law and officer/device directions require separately sourced probes.
